lint.message: Moves peak in speed at 50% of their duration: every move eases in and out the same amount. Measured gestures reach peak speed at 38% (they leave fast and arrive slowly); tired/old characters at ~25%; only snappy, energetic ones near 50%. Put a breakdown key early in the move or favour the arrival.

Right Leg moves in a straight line from 2.20 to 2.30 s (bows 2% of its 0.8-stud path). Organic moves curve: measured arm raises bow 22% of their travel, slashes 36%, even punches 6-12%. Add a breakdown key off the straight line (usually higher, or swinging out).

Recovery (0.10 s) is shorter than the strike (0.27 s). Weight shows in the follow-through: measured punches recover in 1.1-2.6x the strike time at about half its speed; fighting-game normals spend 1.5-2x their startup recovering. If this is a player move, mark where control returns instead of cutting the recovery.
Keys are evenly spaced (every 0.03 s). Action has rhythm: a quick strike between slower anticipation and recovery, holds of different lengths. Re-time the keys so the beats differ.
